jobs.title: Senior Planning Officer
jobs.description:
**We are recruiting for a full time Senior Planning Officer on a permanent basis**
==================================================================================

**Your passion has never had a greater purpose**
================================================


Here at SEPA, we’re connected by a passion that drives us to be purposeful in every action we take – to protect our environment. Through our expertise, we lead projects that make a difference for Scotland, and our workplaces are grounded in respect for that expertise.


That’s why, when you join us as Senior Planning Officer, you’ll discover enriching benefits, meaningful support, and opportunities to learn every day. That’s what it means to be Passionately Purposeful – for our environment, and for your career.


**Work that goes beyond your desk**
===================================


Experts at what we do, we work in a professional way towards our shared goals, knowing the work we do makes a genuine, lasting difference on the environment. As Senior Planning Officer, that involves:


* Produce integrated responses to EIA, LDP, SEA and other consultation ensuring that they reflect our environmental objectives
* Advise strategic and local planners of our policy and environmental objectives and encourage proactive approaches to environmental protection and improvement in relation to built development
* Advise development management planners on the specific implications that may arise from planning proposals; and ensure robust use of evidence in local development plan preparation and delivery
* Develop and manage the consultation process within policy and to relevant service levels
* Build effective relationships with key stakeholders, including planning authorities and the Scottish Government

**Respect for your expertise**
==============================


This is a highly important role within our Evidence \& Water Resilience portfolio, which means you’ll need:


* Relevant experience or qualification equivalent \- Degree in Town and Country or Environmental Planning
* Comprehensive knowledge of the Scottish Planning System
* Specialist and detailed knowledge of Planning and Environmental Legislation with the ability to analyse and interpret legislation, data or stakeholder requirements and translate business requirements to inform policy, strategy or approach
* Proven analytical problem\-solving capability
* Highly developed oral and written communications skills with the experience of providing authoritative advice and guide others on the resolution of issues


Please open the link to the **Senior Planning Officer** role profile link which outlines the core responsibilities and expectations of the role within a defined activity family. Please note the role profile name may be different to the job title being advertised.


**Support that goes beyond the workplace**
==========================================


We’re cultivating a workplace that supports not only your passion and your professional lives, but your personal life. So, you’ll find benefits that make a difference at work and at home. Such as:


* Hybrid and Flexible working opportunities
* Up to 35 days annual leave and 7 additional public holidays each year (pro rata)
* Paid time off to support your Wellbeing and enable you to Volunteer in your community
* Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS)
* Progressive Family Friendly policies
* Training \& development to enablecolleagues to improve their skills, competencies and knowledge to perform at their best.


Plus, many more lifestyle benefits such as 24/7 access to an online employee discount platform, credit union facilities and access to a Cycle to Work Scheme.


**Passionately you. Purposefully supportive**
=============================================


SEPA is committed to promoting equality, diversity, and good relations in everything it does – as a community leader, as a provider and commissioner of services, and as an employer.


Passionately Purposeful about Scotland’s environment – and your career.


Protecting our environment, promoting our work, and supporting our people, working at SEPA means being part of an organisation that’s grounded in respect for your expertise – and your wellbeing. So you can be your best, and make the biggest impact.


We recruit solely based on merit. Our shortlisting process is conducted on an anonymous basis. Please ensure that you include all relevant information when you apply.


We support flexible working arrangements to help you maintain a healthy balance between career and homelife. This includes working part time, reduced hours, job sharing, working remotely. As a flexible first employer we are open to having conversations about flexible working arrangements that work for you and SEPA from day 1 of your employment with us.


We are proud to be a 'Disability Confident' employer and will work to identify and implement reasonable adjustments and equipment to support you in the role that you do.


Applicants with a visual impairment can request job descriptions and application forms in Braille, large print or on tape.


For the security and wellbeing of our colleagues, successful candidates will undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) pre\-employment checks including a level one Disclosure Scotland check.


If you have questions or need any assistance with the recruitment process please contact SEPA’s Recruitment Team at **recruitment@sepa.org.uk**


**Apply now to join a Passionately Purposeful workplace**
=========================================================

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants, Amazon Ads
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Ads is seeking an experienced technical leader to join our Services organization as a Manager of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants, based in London. In this role, you'll lead a team of Technical Enablers supporting Amazon's largest advertisers and agencies across the EU market. You'll be responsible for building and scaling post\-sales technical support capabilities, driving innovation in customer solutions, and ensuring your team delivers exceptional service quality to our enterprise customers.  

  

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300\+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first\-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third\-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.  

  

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e\-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.  

  

As a manager, you will oversee a critical portion of our technical DSP Services team, which works with enterprise agency and advertiser customers. You will manage a team of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants with expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, who are leveraging this expertise to resolve a wide range of technical issues for our customers. Your team provides services ranging from custom training programs, to product and campaign strategy sessions, to technical troubleshooting. We help our customers understand how to integrate our technology into their workflow, driving self\-sufficiency within the Amazon DSP.  

  

You have experience managing a team and are able to work and inspire directly and indirectly across the EU and WW teams. You have a great track record of delivering complex projects and have impressed your stakeholders at all levels with your ability to communicate both written and verbally. You have demonstrated problem\-solving capabilities across both technical and non\-technical teams. The right candidate also possesses strong analytical acumen and is comfortable drawing metric\-based conclusions by managing an extensive amount of data. You stay on top of industry and competitive trends, and you are able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level to drive customer satisfaction.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Navigate a high level of ambiguity. You love whitespace, and treat this space as your own company. You identify key business problems to prioritize then present the solutions to solve them on behalf of the business.

\- Take ownership of managing a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants \- Technical, including resource planning and driving success for the team’s customer category, possessing a complete understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business  

* Work tactically and strategically. Determines the right strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome of the assigned category
* Be comfortable working with data to develop new opportunity areas, track program metrics, and use findings to influence business decisions
* Set goals and direction for the team, ensuring alignment with broader business goals and vision


\- Hire, develop, and lead a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants \- Technical  

* Thrive on technology and data and have expertise in monitoring and managing a services organization to maximum efficiency, productivity, and quality.
* Generate and implement big ideas to drive business improvement, innovation, and scale within the team and across the business as a whole. Lead cross functional collaboration to get big ideas implemented.
* Anticipate bottlenecks, assess risks, mitigate issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade\-offs
* Have strong communication and written skills and experience working across diverse stakeholder groups
* Represent Amazon when meeting with senior executive teams from top customers and build long term strategic relationships

  

A day in the life  

* Lead and develop a team of Technical Enablers who resolve complex campaign execution issues and blockers for enterprise customers, particularly programmatic trading desks
* Drive operational excellence in technical issue resolution, ensuring your team provides knowledgeable and responsive support across our DSP product and processes
* Establish and optimize processes for issue investigation, including identifying campaign configuration and software defects, reproducing complex cases, and researching solutions
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence roadmaps based on customer feedback and technical insights derived from your team's interactions
* Develop and implement strategies to scale service quality, including the creation of tools and automation initiatives
* Own relationships with key stakeholders Services, Product teams, and Support Engineering
* Define and track success metrics around handling time, time to resolution, and service quality
* Build mechanisms to scale knowledge across the organization and enable first\-line support teams
* Provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of customer incidents
* Ensure your team maintains the high customer service bar set by Amazon, recognizing that our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers

jobs.title: Transit Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **Position Summary**


Capital Area Transit System (CATS) is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical **Transit Planning Analyst** to support the planning, evaluation, development, and continuous improvement of CATS fixed\-route transit services.


The Transit Planning Analyst collects, analyzes, and interprets ridership, service\-performance, operational, demographic, and geographic data to evaluate existing service and identify opportunities for improvement. The position provides analytical support for decisions involving routes, schedules, service levels, running and recovery times, bus stops, service changes, and other transit\-planning initiatives.


This position works closely with Transportation Operations, the Transit Service Planning Coordinator, and other departments to help ensure service\-planning recommendations are data\-driven, operationally feasible, accessible, and responsive to community needs.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Service Performance Analysis**

* Analyze ridership, passenger activity, on\-time performance, missed trips, running and recovery times, service hours and miles, and route productivity.
* Evaluate route and system performance to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for service improvement.
* Analyze actual versus scheduled running times and identify recurring delays, bottlenecks, and schedule deficiencies.
* Develop recurring reports, tables, charts, dashboards, and other analytical materials to communicate service\-performance findings.
* Conduct before\-and\-after analysis of implemented service changes.

###### **Route and Service Planning**

* Support analysis and development of recommendations involving route alignments, schedules, frequencies, service spans, running and recovery times, and bus stops.
* Analyze customer demand, population and employment patterns, community access, development activity, and other factors affecting transit demand.
* Support short\-range service planning, including new routes, route extensions, schedule modifications, and service adjustments.
* Evaluate the potential operational and resource impacts of proposed service changes, including vehicle requirements, operator requirements, service hours, and service miles.
* Work with Transportation Operations to evaluate the operational feasibility of proposed changes.

###### **Data, GIS and Transit Technology**

* Maintain, analyze, and report information from available transit data systems, including CAD/AVL, scheduling, ridership, APC, customer, GIS, and related sources.
* Use GIS and mapping tools to evaluate service coverage, accessibility, demographics, bus\-stop locations, and other geographic considerations.
* Support analysis and quality assurance of route, schedule, stop, GIS, and GTFS data.
* Identify data discrepancies and coordinate corrections as appropriate.
* Support the development of maps, presentations, reports, and other planning materials.

###### **Bus Stop and Field Analysis**

* Analyze bus\-stop usage, spacing, accessibility, connectivity, and other service\-planning considerations.
* Conduct field observations, ride checks, travel\-time studies, and other field\-based planning activities.
* Document field conditions and incorporate findings into service\-planning analyses and recommendations.

###### **Planning Coordination and Implementation Support**

* Prepare technical documentation, data summaries, maps, reports, and presentations supporting planning recommendations and service changes.
* Provide analytical support during implementation of approved service changes.
* Monitor service performance following implementation and identify whether additional adjustments may be warranted.
* Collaborate with Transportation, Mobility, Customer Engagement, Maintenance, Information Technology, and other departments as necessary.

##### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Urban or Regional Planning, Transportation Planning, Geography, GIS, Data Analytics, Public Administration, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of directly related education and experience.
* At least two (2\) years of relevant experience in transit planning, transportation planning, service planning, scheduling, operations analysis, GIS, data analysis, performance analysis, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or comparable spreadsheet/data\-analysis tools.
* Ability to identify trends, discrepancies, and relationships within operational or performance data.
* Ability to prepare clear reports, tables, maps, presentations, and other analytical materials.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations.

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in public transit or fixed\-route transportation.
* Experience analyzing ridership, on\-time performance, running times, route productivity, service coverage, or similar transit\-performance measures.
* Experience with GIS or mapping applications.
* Experience with transit scheduling, CAD/AVL, APC, GTFS, or related transit technology.
* Knowledge of transit\-planning principles, service standards, ADA accessibility, Title VI considerations, and FTA requirements.
* Experience conducting field observations, ride checks, travel\-time studies, or similar transportation studies.

##### **Additional Requirements**

* Ability to travel throughout the CATS service area to conduct field observations and ride checks.
* Ability to work occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends when necessary to observe service or support service changes.
* Work is performed in office, transit, and field environments.

**Capital Area Transit System is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Ads is seeking an experienced technical leader to join our Services organization as a Manager of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants, based in London. In this role, you'll lead a team of Technical Enablers supporting Amazon's largest advertisers and agencies across the EU market. You'll be responsible for building and scaling post\-sales technical support capabilities, driving innovation in customer solutions, and ensuring your team delivers exceptional service quality to our enterprise customers.  

  

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300\+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first\-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third\-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.  

  

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e\-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.  

  

As a manager, you will oversee a critical portion of our technical DSP Services team, which works with enterprise agency and advertiser customers. You will manage a team of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants with expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, who are leveraging this expertise to resolve a wide range of technical issues for our customers. Your team provides services ranging from custom training programs, to product and campaign strategy sessions, to technical troubleshooting. We help our customers understand how to integrate our technology into their workflow, driving self\-sufficiency within the Amazon DSP.  

  

You have experience managing a team and are able to work and inspire directly and indirectly across the EU and WW teams. You have a great track record of delivering complex projects and have impressed your stakeholders at all levels with your ability to communicate both written and verbally. You have demonstrated problem\-solving capabilities across both technical and non\-technical teams. The right candidate also possesses strong analytical acumen and is comfortable drawing metric\-based conclusions by managing an extensive amount of data. You stay on top of industry and competitive trends, and you are able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level to drive customer satisfaction.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Navigate a high level of ambiguity. You love whitespace, and treat this space as your own company. You identify key business problems to prioritize then present the solutions to solve them on behalf of the business.

\- Take ownership of managing a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants \- Technical, including resource planning and driving success for the team’s customer category, possessing a complete understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business  

* Work tactically and strategically. Determines the right strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome of the assigned category

\- Hire, develop, and lead a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants \- Technical  

* Thrive on technology and data and have expertise in monitoring and managing a services organization to maximum efficiency, productivity, and quality.
* Generate and implement big ideas to drive business improvement, innovation, and scale within the team and across the business as a whole. Lead cross functional collaboration to get big ideas implemented.
* Anticipate bottlenecks, assess risks, mitigate issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade\-offs
* Have strong communication and written skills and experience working across diverse stakeholder groups
* Represent Amazon when meeting with senior executive teams from top customers and build long term strategic relationships

  

A day in the life  

* Lead and develop a team of Technical Enablers who resolve complex campaign execution issues and blockers for enterprise customers, particularly programmatic trading desks
* Drive operational excellence in technical issue resolution, ensuring your team provides knowledgeable and responsive support across our DSP product and processes
* Establish and optimize processes for issue investigation, including identifying campaign configuration and software defects, reproducing complex cases, and researching solutions

* Develop and implement strategies to scale service quality, including the creation of tools and automation initiatives

* Build mechanisms to scale knowledge across the organization and enable first\-line support teams
* Provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of customer incidents
* Ensure your team maintains the high customer service bar set by Amazon, recognizing that our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers

new_jobs.title: Transit Planning Analyst
new_jobs.description:
##### **Position Summary**


Capital Area Transit System (CATS) is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical **Transit Planning Analyst** to support the planning, evaluation, development, and continuous improvement of CATS fixed\-route transit services.


The Transit Planning Analyst collects, analyzes, and interprets ridership, service\-performance, operational, demographic, and geographic data to evaluate existing service and identify opportunities for improvement. The position provides analytical support for decisions involving routes, schedules, service levels, running and recovery times, bus stops, service changes, and other transit\-planning initiatives.


This position works closely with Transportation Operations, the Transit Service Planning Coordinator, and other departments to help ensure service\-planning recommendations are data\-driven, operationally feasible, accessible, and responsive to community needs.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Service Performance Analysis**

* Analyze ridership, passenger activity, on\-time performance, missed trips, running and recovery times, service hours and miles, and route productivity.
* Evaluate route and system performance to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for service improvement.
* Analyze actual versus scheduled running times and identify recurring delays, bottlenecks, and schedule deficiencies.
* Develop recurring reports, tables, charts, dashboards, and other analytical materials to communicate service\-performance findings.
* Conduct before\-and\-after analysis of implemented service changes.

###### **Route and Service Planning**

* Support analysis and development of recommendations involving route alignments, schedules, frequencies, service spans, running and recovery times, and bus stops.
* Analyze customer demand, population and employment patterns, community access, development activity, and other factors affecting transit demand.
* Support short\-range service planning, including new routes, route extensions, schedule modifications, and service adjustments.
* Evaluate the potential operational and resource impacts of proposed service changes, including vehicle requirements, operator requirements, service hours, and service miles.
* Work with Transportation Operations to evaluate the operational feasibility of proposed changes.

###### **Data, GIS and Transit Technology**

* Maintain, analyze, and report information from available transit data systems, including CAD/AVL, scheduling, ridership, APC, customer, GIS, and related sources.
* Use GIS and mapping tools to evaluate service coverage, accessibility, demographics, bus\-stop locations, and other geographic considerations.
* Support analysis and quality assurance of route, schedule, stop, GIS, and GTFS data.
* Identify data discrepancies and coordinate corrections as appropriate.
* Support the development of maps, presentations, reports, and other planning materials.

###### **Bus Stop and Field Analysis**

* Analyze bus\-stop usage, spacing, accessibility, connectivity, and other service\-planning considerations.
* Conduct field observations, ride checks, travel\-time studies, and other field\-based planning activities.
* Document field conditions and incorporate findings into service\-planning analyses and recommendations.

###### **Planning Coordination and Implementation Support**

* Prepare technical documentation, data summaries, maps, reports, and presentations supporting planning recommendations and service changes.
* Provide analytical support during implementation of approved service changes.
* Monitor service performance following implementation and identify whether additional adjustments may be warranted.
* Collaborate with Transportation, Mobility, Customer Engagement, Maintenance, Information Technology, and other departments as necessary.

##### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Urban or Regional Planning, Transportation Planning, Geography, GIS, Data Analytics, Public Administration, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of directly related education and experience.
* At least two (2\) years of relevant experience in transit planning, transportation planning, service planning, scheduling, operations analysis, GIS, data analysis, performance analysis, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or comparable spreadsheet/data\-analysis tools.
* Ability to identify trends, discrepancies, and relationships within operational or performance data.
* Ability to prepare clear reports, tables, maps, presentations, and other analytical materials.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and translate analytical findings into practical recommendations.

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in public transit or fixed\-route transportation.
* Experience analyzing ridership, on\-time performance, running times, route productivity, service coverage, or similar transit\-performance measures.
* Experience with GIS or mapping applications.
* Experience with transit scheduling, CAD/AVL, APC, GTFS, or related transit technology.
* Knowledge of transit\-planning principles, service standards, ADA accessibility, Title VI considerations, and FTA requirements.
* Experience conducting field observations, ride checks, travel\-time studies, or similar transportation studies.

##### **Additional Requirements**

* Ability to travel throughout the CATS service area to conduct field observations and ride checks.
* Ability to work occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends when necessary to observe service or support service changes.
* Work is performed in office, transit, and field environments.

**Capital Area Transit System is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
